t: The Wet and Forget 1.4 Ltr rapid mould, lichen and algae remover offers an effective solution for cleaning outdoor surfaces. This ready-to-use formula is ideal for maintaining patios, driveways, and exterior walls, effortlessly tackling unsightly mould, lichen, and algae. Featuring a convenient built-in hose attachment, application is quick and simple, requiring no mixing or heavy equipment. Users just attach a garden hose, select the 'on' nozzle setting and spray evenly onto dry surfaces. Its 8-metre reach nozzle allows access to high or difficult areas, and the solution works with rainfall to gently wash away contamination over time, ensuring a clean finish with minimal effort.
b: No Scrubbing, Rinsing & Jet Washing Needed
